_comment: SEEDANCE 2.5 (paid, ComfyUI API node) with reference images - the engine the Alter Anime Studio breakdown uses, wired to take this studio's own composed start frame and character references. Up to 30 s, 1080p, native audio, up to 30 reference pictures. Driven by studio/_tools/fight.py --seedance.
_notes: AUTH: API nodes need a Comfy account token supplied by the ComfyUI front end after login. There is none on this box, so this graph fails until somebody signs in at http://192.168.0.45:8188 with the account that holds the credits. Nothing here can create an account or pay.

The reference slots are FLAT DOTTED ids read off the live schema: model.reference_images.image_1, model.reference_images.image_2, model.reference_images.image_3 ... up to image_30. A nested dict is silently ignored (§97.3).
ref1 is the composed start frame (workflow 75), ref2 and ref3 the character references - the breakdown's 'start frame + @CHARAC refs' on one node.
model.prompt takes the shot direction; spoken lines go in double quotes and the engine voices and lip-syncs them. model.duration is 4-30 s. model.task_type: reference | edit | extend.
COSTS MONEY PER RUN. One 5 s 1080p generation is a few cents to a few tens of cents depending on the model tier; check the price in the ComfyUI node before a batch.
